expected.subject: James, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi James,

I'm with Legora, the legal AI platform for M&A used by partners at Goodwin and White & Case.

As Partner, M&A, you're probably still spending too much time guiding associates through repetitive NDA, purchase agreement, and disclosure document review deal after deal.

I'd love to share the use cases that other attorneys are using heavily for similar work in your practice area and hear your thoughts.

Would you be interested in seeing a brief demo?

William
Legora

notes: BAHR M&A Partner, 180 lawyers, Norway. Senior title → SMB+ → demo CTA as soft question.
